narrative.overview:
Desk treats every figure the way a banknote treats its value. The denomination is printed large, in one place, where the eye lands first, and around it runs the fine print that proves the note is genuine. On Desk the denomination is the month's remaining budget, and the fine print is the serial line under each amount: its original currency and amount, the ECB rate used, the date of that rate and its source.

The world lends four things only: a committed palette (an intaglio-teal plate for the shell and the primary action, on faintly sage note paper), system UI words with system mono figures, a working density, and the serial line. Layout, navigation and controls stay standard web ones. No guilloche, rosettes, watermarks or engraved borders.

Three theme states are built in, surfaces lift at two heights, and motion is feedback only (120 to 280ms), dropping to zero under reduced motion. Proposed in ADR-0006; the Ledger Desk is the fallback.
keyCharacteristics: An intaglio-teal plate: the shell header and the primary action share the one accent.
One denomination per screen, ink-reversed, at Display size.
Every figure in a system mono with tabular numerals, at every size.
The serial line under each tile figure, revealed on focus in table rows.
Budget bars filled with a fine line hatch, solid Critical Red when over.
Lifted surfaces at two heights, crisp 2/4/8px corners.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Intaglio Teal is the only accent. It marks the shell, the primary action, the current location and spend against budget, and nothing decorative.

rules.name: The Status Is Not a Series Rule
rules.body: Warn Amber and Critical Red never appear as a chart series, category colour or account colour.

rules.name: The Focus Is Blue Rule
rules.body: The focus ring is Focus Blue, 2px, with a 2px offset, on every interactive element in both themes, including on the teal plate.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every amount, rate and date is set in the figure face with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The One Numeral Face Rule
rules.body: One figure face from the Display denomination to the smallest serial line.

rules.name: The Two Heights Rule
rules.body: Exactly two elevations, Raised and Overlay. No third shadow, no hairline instead of a shadow.

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: Exactly one element per screen is ink-reversed: the denomination.

dos: Do give each screen exactly one denomination, and make it the largest figure on the screen.
Do set every amount, rate and date in the figure face with tabular numerals.
Do show the serial line on tiles and reveal it on focus in rows.
Do keep Intaglio Teal to the shell, the primary action, the current location and spend.
Do lift tiles and panels with Raised and use Overlay only above the page.
Do use the 2px Focus Blue ring with a 2px offset everywhere.
Do give every panel skeleton, empty and error states with copy chosen by cause.
Do define colours as tokens in all three theme states.
donts: Don't add guilloche, rosettes, watermarks, portraits, microtext textures or engraved borders.
Don't reverse a second element to ink.
Don't add a chart library, a third shadow, a second accent or a second numeral face.
Don't reuse Warn Amber or Critical Red as a series, category or account colour.
Don't use teal for focus; focus is always blue.
